title: Generic prime-constant filtration step in second cohomology
statement: Let k be algebraically closed and D/k a smooth integral affine connected curve [def-sc-curves], with generic inclusion eta:Spec k(D) to D [def-sc-function-field]. Let S be a short exact sequence of generic abelian etale sheaves, with third term isomorphic to the constant Z/ell sheaf [def-sc-constant-sheaves] for a prime ell. If H²(D,Z/ell) and H²(D,eta_*S.X_1) are subsingleton [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], then H²(D,eta_*S.X_2) is subsingleton. No finiteness hypothesis on the first or second term is needed.

proof.text: Write G_j for the generic direct images, I for the image of G_2 to G_3, and Q for its cokernel. Left exactness gives the short exact sequences 0 to G_1 to G_2 to I to 0 and 0 to I to G_3 to Q to 0.

The generic pullback/pushforward counit is invertible by stalk comparison. Exact inverse image identifies the generic restriction of Q with the cokernel of S.g, hence zero. G_3 and Q are killed by ell because the third generic term is constant Z/ell. Thus Q is torsion and generically zero. Continuity of sections at the generic-point limit makes each section of Q vanish locally on a nonempty affine open, which is the hypothesis of generic acyclicity. Generic acyclicity gives H¹(Q)=H²(Q)=0.

Smoothness over a field implies normality, and finite type implies Noetherianity. Normal generic constant comparison identifies G_3 with D.constantZMod ell, after transporting along the canonical generic residue-field/function-field identification. hconstant gives H²(G_3)=0.
The long exact sequence for I,G_3,Q identifies H²(I) with H²(G_3), using H¹(Q)=H²(Q)=0. In the sequence for G_1,G_2,I, both groups flanking H²(G_2) vanish, by hfirst and H²(I)=0, so H²(G_2)=0.

theorem subsingleton_generic_prime_filtration_step
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {D : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : D ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve g] [Smooth g] [IsAffine D] [IsIntegral D]
    (S : ShortComplex (Sheaf (Spec D.functionField).smallEtaleTopology
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) (hS : S.ShortExact) (ℓ : ℕ) (hℓ : ℓ.Prime)
    (e : S.X₃ ≅ (Spec D.functionField).constantZMod ℓ)
    (hconstant : Subsingleton (Sheaf.H (D.constantZMod ℓ) 2))
    (hfirst : Subsingleton (Sheaf.H
      ((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} D.fromSpecFunctionField).obj S.X₁) 2)) :
    Subsingleton (Sheaf.H
      ((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} D.fromSpecFunctionField).obj S.X₂) 2)
